note: Each place belongs to one area, and each catalogue record to one or more places, most specific first. kind 'place' is one location the text treats as the same; kind 'group' gathers similar locations or a school-wide subject without claiming identity. This is a navigation layer, not evidence.

places.title: Castle exterior
places.scope: The castle seen from outside: silhouette, towers and turrets, outer walls, windows seen from the grounds, and its cliff setting.

places.title: Courtyards
places.scope: Open courtyards within the castle. The text rarely distinguishes them, so these records are not claimed to be one courtyard.

places.title: Castle interiors in general
places.scope: School-wide interior conditions not tied to one room: seasonal decoration, lighting, cold, maintenance, curfews, patrols and movement rules.

places.title: Protections and security
